scope: The nine explicitly selected upstream roots only; exact source partition verified against disk and the complete all-source scan seed.
mapping_policy: Historical mapping candidates and existing Build presence are not implementation credit. Every row is a source-derived plan; reused targets still need complete basic export and behavior verification for each listed obligation.

python_files.responsibility: APLIC/IMSIC hardware and both source-owned TileLink and AXI4 topologies. The existing compact register boundary is only a starting candidate; it does not cover the six Scala files by itself.
required_configuration_modes: IMSIC M/S/guest files and TEE enabled/disabled

python_files.responsibility: ChiselIOPMP register/config table, request checking and AXI bridge; preserve APB setup/access, range matching, permission/error reports and interrupt behavior despite absence from the selected top.
required_configuration_modes: APB register widths and write-one semantics
NA4/NAPOT range modes and partial/full address overlap

python_files.responsibility: Difftest hardware-facing ABI and real trace/control transactions. DPI software callbacks require the separate Runtime-Hdl contract and cannot be represented by an output-less or zero-value RTL shell.
required_configuration_modes: trace FIFO depth, overflow, reset and backpressure
AXI/AXI-lite interface widths and outstanding transactions

python_files.responsibility: Difftest commit, architectural state, event, batching, delta, replay, squash, trace, and top-down stateful endpoints. Current CONTRACT_ONLY members remain pending real state equations and direct/reference evidence.
Fudian shared CLZ, carry-save adder, leading-zero anticipation, multiplier and shift-right-jam arithmetic helpers.
Fudian floating-point add/compare/multiply/FMA/divide/square-root/conversion and rounding family.
required_configuration_modes: iterative divide/square-root state and pipeline latency

python_files.responsibility: Shared utility API and configuration records used by the external families; this target is not blanket credit for the 62 Utility source files.
Bit extraction, masks, one-hot/prefix selection, priority/parallel mux, lookup, and signed/unsigned field helpers.
Hold, delay, pipeline, register-slice, latency, and valid/ready state helpers.
Queue, circular pointer, arbitration, SRAM-backed queue and MBIST pipeline/control families.

Remaining source-backed utility behavior including ECC, memory templates, CAM, clock/reset control, replacement, register maps, and performance counter state. Host macros and generated files are separately classified.

New aggregate for the distinct YunSuan full-FPU and fpulite source families; preserve each implementation variant and its own latency/rounding behavior instead of folding them into a generic vector boundary.
required_configuration_modes: rounding, exceptional values, divide and square-root iterations

python_files.responsibility: Scalar YunSuan conversion, format selection, rounding, and scalar FPU control. Current file presence does not establish full source coverage or behavior.
required_configuration_modes: full versus lite helper selection where consumed

python_files.responsibility: Vector integer/floating arithmetic, conversion, reductions, permutation, iterative divide/square-root, and vector control support. The vector source set remains pending a source-derived behavior inventory.
CoupledL2 CHI message layouts and TL2CHI adapter, link activation/credit accounting, CHI RX/TX channel state, MMIO bridge, MSHR, snoop and slice behavior.
CoupledL2 tag/meta directory lookup, replacement selection, reset scrub, refill retry/occupied-way exclusion, ECC and MBIST/DFT access.

Shared source-backed CoupledL2 transaction records, storage/prefetch/monitor helpers and common slice behavior. It is a reusable child family; parent topology and the TL2TL/CHI protocol engines have separate Build targets.
New TileLink-to-TileLink CoupledL2 protocol family aggregate; separates Acquire/MainPipe/MSHR/ProbeQueue/Refill/SinkB/SourceC state from the broad common Slice boundary.
required_configuration_modes: TileLink A-E opcode/size/source and beat geometry
SinkB probe backpressure and SourceC release beats
directory retry, flush and refill response

python_files.responsibility: New CoupledL2 parent Build for the BaseSlice/CoupledL2 wrapper path; selects and wires the common, Directory, TL2TL and CHI family APIs through controller injection.
required_configuration_modes: bank count/slice ID and L1 client geometry
L2 flush, async source-ready and optional monitor/DFT wiring

python_files.responsibility: Shared HuanCun cache path: TileLink A-E traffic, directory/data storage, source/sink control, refill, prefetch, ECC/DFT and shared queue helpers.
Inclusive HuanCun directory/MSHR/SinkC transaction family, including allocation, retained source/address, refill completion, release/probe and cancellation.
Non-inclusive HuanCun directory/MSHR/probe helper/slice control bridge, with probe/snoop ordering and TileLink handshakes.
OpenLLC CHI TX/RX channel adapters, flit packing, ready/valid transfers, link activation, and credit accounting.
OpenLLC CHI cache pipeline: request classification, directory/coherence transitions, refill/data storage, memory/response/snoop units, multi-bank parent wiring and sideband status.
required_configuration_modes: CHI issue variant and RN/SN counts

python_files.responsibility: The 89-file OpenNCB family: AXI4 and CHI channel ABI, transaction ID/order/age/free-list state, request/data/response queues, burst conversion, and link-credit control.
required_configuration_modes: CHI Issue encoding and flit widths
AXI read/write ordering and burst lengths

python_files.responsibility: OpenLLC bank routing, MMIO transaction-ID divergence/merge, TargetBinder elaboration, and synchronous SRAM read/write forwarding.

python_runtime_files.responsibility: Pure-standard-library deterministic trace/DPI endpoint contract: event schema, callback registration/dispatch, reset and enable gates, event order, bounded queues/backpressure and explicit missing-endpoint errors. It does not rewrite or claim compatibility with external C++ implementations.
required_configuration_modes: bounded trace queue and overflow policy
external C++/DPI function names remain an explicit environment contract
